end.summary:
Discussed why covered bins help keep away smells and flies.
Explained that keeping school clean is everyone’s shared responsibility, including students and visitors.
Practised sorting peels as wet waste and wrappers/cups as dry waste.
The child repeatedly said that plastic spoons or bottles can rot in a compost pit; this was not corrected by the end.
end.parentNote: Asha practised school cleanliness, shared responsibility, waste sorting, and how a compost pit works. Anika gave reasons for covered bins and connected putting rubbish in bins with reducing litter and keeping the school clean.
